text:
maria: Quick spike summary — proposing a new "delegated task key" (DTK) primitive: short-lived, route-scoped keys that a service account can mint for downstream jobs. Sketch: https://go/redwood/dtk-spike :spiral_note_pad:

aj: Nice. How do we make sure billing and quota attribution are correct? If infra mints a DTK on behalf of Project A but the job runs under infra, we need charges to land in Project A's usage bucket.

devon: We should include an origin claim at mint time. Example header the minting flow attaches: `X-Redwood-Origin: project:proj-123`. Router + billing will use that for routing and accounting.

samira: Console UX: minting UI should require an explicit "delegate to project" checkbox and TTL slider — default TTL short (e.g., 15m). Also show permitted routes so people know what that key can do.

maria: Agreed. Also want each DTK to carry an allowlist of permitted endpoints (e.g., `/v1/generate`, `/v1/embeddings`) so the gateway/authz can reject anything outside the list.

aj: Gateway-level checks could be expensive for every request. Can we push allowlist enforcement into the authz service and have the gateway consult a small cache?

devon: Yes — plan: gateway forwards the DTK id + origin header, authz service is authoritative for allowlist. Gateway keeps a short-lived cache (TTL 30s) for common keys to avoid a round-trip on every token.

maria: Proto example for request payload we expect after mint: 

```http
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer DTK.xyz.eyJ...
X-Redwood-Origin: project:proj-123
X-Redwood-DTK-ID: dtk-87a3
X-Redwood-Req-Route: model:gpt-small,latency:edge
```

devon: Telemetry note: authz should emit a single attribution event when a DTK is used: fields = project, service_account, dtk_id, tokens_consumed, region. Important: do not double-count (i.e., router & billing must consume the same attribution event).

samira: Cross-org delegation gets tricky. We need an explicit consent flow: when a DTK would attribute to a different org, require an owner approval and record audit events in console. UX: show pending DTK approvals and ability to revoke.

maria: Rollout plan suggestion: default OFF for existing service accounts; new service accounts can opt-in. Canary to 10% of orgs, enable telemetry flag `delegation.minting` for fine-grained sampling.

aj: Quota precedence question — if a DTK is minted for Project A but the issuing SA has a lower cap, which quota wins?

devon: Implement waterfall evaluation: project-level quota overrides SA when the request carries a project origin. If project quota absent, fall back to SA then org. This keeps project-level billing authoritative.

maria: Also need a migration helper: a reporting job that simulates attribution for existing calls so customers can see "what would have been billed to project X" before enabling.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: lint(authz-proto): OK; rollout job queued to canary env (10% orgs). CI: green.

samira: I'll drop a couple mockups in #design shortly (mint flow, revoke list, audit feed).

aj: I'll open an RFC branch with the authz proto changes and the gateway cache sketch.

maria: SGTM. tagging @devon for router capacity mapping and @samira for console copy. :thumbsup:
